ui.command: if [ ! -x node_modules/.bin/vite ]; then echo 'docker/ui/app/node_modules is missing. Run: tedos lock run heavy --wait -- npm ci (in docker/ui/app), then tedos dev up ui again.'; exit 1; fi; echo "API proxy: /api/ -> ${VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET:-http://localhost:8000} (set VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET in your shell to change it)"; exec node_modules/.bin/vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$WEB_PORT" --strictPort
